{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {missing_age.shape[0]}")

# Check revenue string format
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))"}
